provenance.observed_pattern: IS_IPV4 classifies valid, malformed, and NULL IPv4 text.
provenance.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one deterministic scalar SELECT; no table or regular-expression guard remains.

fixture_notes: The literals cover a valid documentation-network address, a malformed address with an out-of-range octet, and SQL NULL; MariaDB returns 1, 0, and 0 respectively.
determinism_notes: All inputs are literals; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT IS_IPV4('192.0.2.17') AS valid_flag, IS_IPV4('999.1.1.1') AS invalid_flag, IS_IPV4(NULL) AS null_flag
